verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a standing deprecations page that tracks announced earliest shutdown dates per model. Deprecations are announced in a maintained, dated release-notes changelog. The changelog also shows the alias policy: `-latest` aliases move on each release while versioned model IDs stay pinnable. Missing for 10: evidence of API surface/endpoint versioning (as opposed to model versioning), a stated minimum deprecation notice window, and independent or hands-on corroboration of how the policy works in practice.
